hero.subtitle: Learn touch typing the playful way. Master the finger positions, then let speed follow. No account, no ads, no fuss.

features.subtitle: A focused set of tools built around one idea: practice, get measured, improve.

features.speedDesc: Timed 15 / 30 / 60-second rounds with WPM, accuracy and consistency charts.
features.statsDesc: Every session is saved on your device so you can watch yourself improve.
